Ravi (Product): Heads-up: low-latency callbacks (realtime toolcall v2) are GA on Hosted API today. Rolling now, expect full global coverage within 4 hours. :tada:

Lina (Eng): Nice. What's new vs v1?

Ravi (Product): v2 combines streaming + callback orchestration with smaller first-byte latency, and adds a client-friendly "callback_timeout_ms" param. Router supports route-level preference for low_tail_latency. Backwards compatible with v1 endpoints.

Sam (SRE): Rollout plan? Canary windows and metrics to watch?

Ravi (Product): Canary in eu-west-1 for 30m, then staged ramp to other regions. Watch tail_latency_99, callback.failure_rate, and router.priority_mismatch. Alert if callback.failure_rate > 1% sustained for 10m.

DeployBot: deploy started: hosted-realtime v3.4 -> canary(eu-west-1) at 1840123600. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/hosted-realtime/3.4

Lina (Eng): Runtime note: callback workers now prefetch tool manifests to avoid cold-tool latency. We also added a soft limit on concurrent callbacks per-tenant to protect P99.

SupportBot: New API error code 4602 = callback-timeout, recommended retry strategy: exponential backoff + switch to streaming-only if persistent.

Elaine (Docs): I'll update the API page and the migration guide. Who can give a short sample curl and a JSON example for callback payload?

Lina (Eng): Sample streaming+callback request (curl):
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/realtime-toolcall-v2 \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"mosaic-4b","prompt":"Extract entities","tool_calling":"callbacks","callback_url":"https://hooks.example/app","callback_timeout_ms":5000,"routing_preference":"low_tail_latency"}'
```

Ravi (Product): Quick notes for customers: callback requests reduce end-to-end latency for UI flows that can handle asynchronous tool output. There is a small cost premium per callback; advise teams to use routing_preference when latency is critical.

Sam (SRE): I'll provision dashboards and add runbook entry for 4602 + router.priority_mismatch. Putting an alert: callback.failure_rate > 1% for 10m -> pager.

DeployBot: canary completed: hosted-realtime v3.4 -> eu-west-1 OK (1840124200). Next: staged ramp to us-west-2 at +20m.

Elaine (Docs): ETA for docs update: 90 minutes. Will include migration tips and cost table.

Ravi (Product): Blog and changelog links posted: https://internal.redwood/blog/realtime-toolcall-v2-ga and https://internal.redwood/changelog#realtime-toolcall-v2

SupportBot: Support snippet ready: "If users see error 4602, suggest increasing callback_timeout_ms or switch to streaming-only endpoint. Contact support with request-id for deeper debugging"

Ravi (Product): Thanks team. Please react with :thumbsup: when done. We'll keep an eye on metrics and follow up in #incidents if anything shows up during ramp.

Lina (Eng): :thumbsup:

Sam (SRE): :thumbsup:

Elaine (Docs): :thumbsup:

Ravi (Product): Rollout complete across regions at 1840126740. If you spot any customer-impacting regressions, ping me or @oncall immediately.
